title: CompactLogix
summary: Logix controller family for small and mid-size machines with local I/O and EtherNet/IP.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: CompactLogix controllers carry local I/O modules on the right side (1769 Compact I/O on older models, 5069 Compact 5000 I/O on newer ones). Each module's data is visible as structured tags.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body:
PLC Lab uses this profile to present addresses, analog raw values and product names in the style of the platform. The PLC itself is always PLC Lab's single generic IEC 61131-3 runtime; programs are written in PLC Lab Structured Text, not in the vendor's dialect. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION**: details such as exact diagnostic texts, timing and module parameters differ from the real product.

The profile presents analog values in engineering units (REAL), as configured scaling on Logix analog modules typically does.

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Analog channels deliver REAL engineering units (mA or V)
Module-defined tag names are generated by PLC Lab
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
